title: Autofarm | GodMode | Infinite Fuel | Custom Speed
features:
- Godmode (don't die from any obstacles.)
- Speed multiplier. (from 1x to 59x (59x is the max possible, more speed and you don't get any cash when returning.)) 
- Auto claim quests
- Infinite Fuel
- Auto fly (with return distance settings and speed.) you NEED to play with the speed settings, as the speed you get depend of the base speed of the plane, and going too fast will not get you any cash.
- Automaticly send the current stock to your discord webhook.
- Parts shop item selector, with auto buy selected part.
- Auto buy all parts. (ignoring the selected list.)
- Tools shop item selector, with auto buy selected Tools.
- Auto buy all Tools. (ignoring the selected list)
